name: Alhammarret's Archive
oracle_text:
If you would gain life, you gain twice that much life instead.
If you would draw a card except the first one you draw in each of your draw steps, draw two cards instead.
blocked_sentences: If you would gain life, you gain twice that much life instead.

needs.what: a player-wide static replacement effect that modifies each life gain event for the affected player (affects_player: "you"), multiplying the amount gained by a gain_multiplier (2 here: Alhammarret's Archive, Boon Reflection, Rhox Faithmender)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: replace_life_loss with loss_multiplier only replaces life loss, and replace_draw / replace_token_creation cover other events; the you_gain_life trigger with gain_life would be a separate triggered gain (uses the stack, triggers life-gain triggers twice, and is not a replacement), which is an approximation
